_comment: Editorial content for CLVL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. products is empty: the company publishes no product or service list, and inventing one would misstate a business that changed line only in 2021.
description: Cordoba Logistics & Ventures Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 1 December 1986 as Mian Textile Industries Limited, and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. After Mr Danish Elahi acquired 70% of its paid-up capital in April 2021, shareholders changed its principal line of business to logistics and other ventures and its name to Cordoba Logistics & Ventures Limited in August 2021. The company describes its mission as adding value through active portfolio management for shareholders.
headOffice: Office No. 420, 4th Floor, Eden Towers, Main Boulevard, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan
